name: Jellyfin Exporter
description: Export movies, shows and seasons to a folder using FFmpeg profiles (codec, resolution, audio channels).
overview: Pick movies, series or seasons in the dashboard, choose an export profile, and let Jellyfin's own FFmpeg (hardware acceleration when available) write the files to a directory you control.

versions.changelog: Add library browse page that queues exports by profile
Export engine: FFmpeg command builder, Movies/TV output layout, hardware acceleration detection and the background queue worker.
Initial scaffold: plugin entry point, configuration page, shared export models and installable release packaging.
